Пропиленгликоля Монолаурат CAS — 27194-74-7. Pharmacopoeias. In Eur. (see p.vii). Also in USNF. Ph. Eur. 6.2 (Propylene Glycol Monolaurate). A mixture of the propylene glycol mono- and di-esters of lauric acid. It contains 45 to 70% of mono-esters and 30 to 55% of di-esters (type I) or a minimum of 90% of mono-esters and a maximum of 10% of di-esters (type II). The content of free propylene glycol is not more than 5% (type I) or not more than 1% (type II). A colourless or slightly yellow, clear oily liquid at 20°.
